title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: 汉语中的 "福"字 (the character fu)表示幸福和好运,是中国传统文化中最常用的吉祥(auspicious) 符号之一。人们通常将一个大大的福字写在红纸上, 寓意期盼家庭幸福、社会安定、国家昌盛。春节贴福字是民间由来已久的习俗。为了欢庆春节, 家家户户都会将福字贴在门上或墙上, 表达对幸福生活的向往、对美好未来的期待。人们有时还将福字倒过来贴，表示幸福已到、好运已到。
reference: The Chinese character "Fu" means happiness and good fortune, and is one of the most commonly used auspicious symbols in traditional Chinese culture. People usually write a large character "Fu" on red paper, expressing their wish for family happiness, social stability and national prosperity. Pasting the character "Fu" during the Spring Festival is a long-standing folk custom. To celebrate the Spring Festival, every household pastes the character "Fu" on doors or walls, expressing their longing for a happy life and their expectation for a better future. Sometimes people also paste the character "Fu" upside down to indicate that happiness and good fortune have arrived.
